subject: SOC2 Request — personnel lifecycle automation sample artifacts
messages:
From: Oliver McKay <oliver.mckay@cedarbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 review

Diego,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review next quarter and need a small sample of evidence focused on personnel lifecycle controls. Specifically CedarBank Compliance has asked for: 
- A redacted sample training roster (CSV) showing completion timestamps and role labels (no PII).
- An example of a redacted background-check result and the attestation we store.
- Our offboarding automation logs showing deprovisioning steps (timestamped) for one terminated contractor.
- The playbook or runbook that describes the automated offboard workflow (PDF preferred).

Can you provide a short list of artifacts (redacted) and an estimated delivery date? If there's any doc we should sign/acknowledge (NDA or DPA addendum) to share artifacts, let me know.

Thanks,
Oliver McKay
Manager, Vendor Risk & Third Party Assurance
CedarBank

(P.S. please flag anything that would be sensitive so we can scope our internal review.)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver McKay <oliver.mckay@cedarbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 review

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a small, redacted bundle that meets those asks. Plan below: 

1) training-roster-sample.csv — a 10-row export with job role, training module, completion timestamp, and an internal training-id. All names/emails will be removed; we will keep "role" and "module" fields intact.
2) offboard-automation-playbook.pdf — internal runbook (redacted) describing the automated steps (IAM revoke, token invalidation, workspace deprovision, access list updates).
3) redaction-summary.txt — short note that details what was redacted and why (PII, gov ID numbers, payroll IDs).
4) offboard-log-sample.json (log stub) — a chronological event list for a terminated contractor showing timestamps and system actions. We'll include as a .json stub (no raw identifiers).

Delivery: we can assemble and upload a presigned S3 bundle by Tue 12 Jan EOD PST. If you need an earlier turnaround we can prioritize.

Legal/Sharing: we typically provide redacted artifacts under our standard evidence-sharing DPA; no additional NDA required for redacted samples, but if you prefer we can add a short data-handling attestation before delivery.

I'll loop in Kimberley and Naomi for redaction and export.

— Diego Fernandez
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will be included in link)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 review

Diego / Naomi —

Quick note on redaction scope: payroll IDs and government ID numbers must be removed; for contractor records we should keep contractor-role and start/end dates but truncate any free-text notes that may include client names. I recommend we also replace internal employee IDs with a stable pseudo-id (e.g., RW-EX-###) so auditors can follow a trail without seeing PHI/PII.

Naomi, can you prepare the training roster export and run a search-and-redact pass? Marissa, could you review the offboard runbook redactions for any client-specific references?

One operational ask — for the offboard logs, we should convert timestamps to ISO-8601 and include a short header explaining retention policy and who executed each remediation action (role, not username).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of People Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
